test.description: US Core Condition Encounter Diagnosis Profile requires Condition.category (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses Condition whose category does not fill slice us-core
test.description: US Core Condition Encounter Diagnosis Profile requires slice Condition.category:us-core. A category value no slice matches leaves the slice empty and the resource is refused.

test.name: Refuses Condition with more than 1 category:us-core
test.description: US Core Condition Encounter Diagnosis Profile allows at most 1 of slice Condition.category:us-core. 2 are refused.

test.name: Refuses Condition without code
test.description: US Core Condition Encounter Diagnosis Profile requires Condition.code (at least 1); base FHIR leaves it optional. Without it the resource is refused.
